name: Quicksilver Draught
text: Once per battle, in any combat phase, the general has Strike-first for the rest of that phase.

name: Null Pendant
text: Once per battle, at the end of any turn, roll a dice for each enemy unit contesting the same objective as the general. For each 2+, subtract the roll from that unit's control score this turn.

name: Morrda's Talon
text: The general's Hallowed Greataxe has Crit (Mortal).
